entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Inca Empire, a political institution in Argentina during Inca Expansion and Early European Contact (1480–1535). Grew from Shincal de Quimivil established as Inca administrative center and Topa Inca Yupanqui conquers northwestern Argentina c. 1480. Led to the emergence of Incas and Díaz de Solís reaches Río de la Plata.
